caseName: Moritt v. Extraordinary Special & Trial Term of the Supreme Court, County of Kings
caseNameFull: Moritt v. Extraordinary Special and Trial Term of the Supreme Court, County of Kings

opinions.text: Appeal from App. Div., Sup. Ct. N. Y., 2d Jud. Dept., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
